en: A black-and-white postcard image showing a picturesque riverside scene with a large building resembling a small castle or manor house on a hill, surrounded by lush trees and ivy. The building has a tall, pointed turret and elaborate architectural features typical of late 19th or early 20th-century European manor houses. In the foreground, a person is rowing a small boat on a calm river. The area is landscaped with decorative trees and a stone embankment. There are no visible modern buildings or vehicles.
